name: Beaconing Activity linked to Vane Viper from win11-50-10-7
description: This insight is raised when an asset contacts a domain consistently across many hours with low volume, suggesting beaconing.

top_indicators.description: Domain recently associated with adware activity and linked to Vane Viper, a malvertising network that uses browser redirects and traffic-distribution techniques to push persistent ads. Observed in 24 events on 1 asset between June 6, 2026 and June 7, 2026, and traffic was not blocked.

OSINT reports this domain directs users to malicious Chrome extensions, which can lead to unwanted browser changes and data exposure. Observed in 24 events on 1 asset between June 6, 2026 and June 7, 2026, and traffic was blocked.

top_assets.description: Verified host win11-50-10-7 (10.50.10.7) generated 48 web events from June 6, 2026 to June 7, 2026 tied to two indicators: 24 connections to 2plyr.com (Vane Viper malvertising/adware, not blocked) and 24 to calendlydaily.world (malicious Chrome extension lure, blocked). Investigate user Dhwani Shah’s browser activity and extension installs, and review why 2plyr.com traffic was allowed to confirm potential adware/redirect compromise.

threat_actors.actor_description: Malvertising network that not only abuses push notifications, pop-ups, and redirects within a browser but continues to serve ads even after the user navigates away from the initial page.

overview: Hourly beaconing pattern from a single endpoint: Across 48 events between June 6, 2026 and June 7, 2026, win11-50-10-7 repeatedly contacted the same external domains with steady hourly regularity, which matters because this persistence is more consistent with automated beaconing than user-driven browsing and implies an installed browser component or background process maintaining outbound callbacks.

Active exposure remains due to an unblocked malvertising/adware domain: Half of the activity was unblocked (24 of 48 events), with win11-50-10-7 continuing to reach 2plyr.com, which matters because it aligns with malvertising/adware infrastructure linked to Vane Viper and implies the endpoint may still be participating in a redirect or adware communication chain.

Blocked extension-lure traffic suggests attempted follow-on delivery: The remaining 24 events were blocked attempts to calendlydaily.world, which matters because it is associated with luring users to malicious Chrome extensions and implies the same beaconing workflow is attempting to pivot into extension or browser-based persistence even when some requests are prevented.
